activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1835 as Andersen's representative Danish literary breakthrough year, when the first Fairy Tales, Told for Children booklets appeared and began the fairy-tale authorship for which he became globally known.

sources.title: The fairy tale author Hans Christian Andersen — Royal Danish Library
sources.citation_text: The Royal Danish Library states that Andersen's fairy-tale authorship began in 1835 and that the first Fairy Tales, Told for Children booklets were issued from 1835 onward.
